fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor, inlined in the fighter boma builder f_71006882d0 (near 0x710068a478), stores vptr 0x7104f85c38 and then stores the object at boma+0xB8. Only one class exists (fighter only).

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Constructor stores the BattleObjectModuleAccessor here (stored together with the vptr). set (slot +0x48) reaches StatusModule via [+0x8]+0x40 (status_kind, vtable +0x110) and WorkModule via [+0x8]+0x50 (param float, vtable +0x270).

fields.name: combo_type
fields.evidence: set (export ComboModule__set_impl, slot +0x48, f_71006b6ac0) stores its int argument here; if the new type differs from the stored one it first calls clear_setting. Values: FIGHTER_COMBO_TYPE_NONE 0 / HIT 1 / SUCCEED 2 / UNIQ_DANCE 3 / TERM 4, plus 5 and 6 (unnamed); set picks no window for types > 6. Types 4..6 are the input-window types (is_enable_combo_input and update test type-4 <= 2). Initial -1; clear_setting writes -1.

fields.name: count
fields.evidence: count (slot +0x68, f_71006b6d60) returns the u32 here. set: if window_frame >= 0 and the current status_kind equals the one recorded at +0x1C, count = count+1, else count = 1. Initial 0; clear_setting writes 0 (high half of the 64-bit store at +0x10).

fields.name: window_frame
fields.how: computed: frames left in the combo-continuation window; -1 = closed
fields.evidence: set loads a WorkModule param float (vtable +0x270, hash + sub-hash) chosen by type and count and stores it truncated to int here (0 becomes -1): type 0 count1 combo_attack_12_end, count2 combo_attack_13_end; types 1/4 count1 combo_attack_32_end, count2 combo_attack_33_end; type 2 count1 combo_attack_42_end (ParamLabels); types 3/5 use the hash pairs at +0x28 (count1) / +0x38 (count2); type 6 uses +0x50 (count1) / +0x60 (count2). update (slot +0x50, f_71006b6cb0) decrements it each frame unless window_hold (+0x48) is set; at <= 0 it calls clear_setting for types outside 4..6, or zeroes it and enable_combo_input (+0x70) for 4..6. Initial -1; clear_setting writes -1.

fields.name: status_kind_at_set
fields.evidence: set stores StatusModule status_kind (StatusModule vtable +0x110) here at the end of every call and compares it with the current status kind at the next call to decide whether count increments. Initial -1; clear_setting writes -1.

fields.name: uniq_combo_id_a
fields.evidence: Written only by the non-exported setter at vtable +0x80 (f_71006b6d90, int argument); no reader among the class's methods. Grouped with the two hash pairs at +0x28/+0x38 (type 3/5 window params), so likely an identifier for that custom combo. Initial -1.

fields.name: uniq_window_param_1
fields.how: plain load (two u64: param hash, sub-hash)
fields.evidence: Setter vtable +0x88 (f_71006b6da0) stores two 64-bit arguments here; set passes them as (hash, sub-hash) to WorkModule param float for types 3/5 when count == 1. Initial 0.

fields.name: uniq_window_param_2
fields.how: plain load (two u64: param hash, sub-hash)
fields.evidence: Setter vtable +0x90 (f_71006b6db0); used by set for types 3/5 when count == 2. Initial 0.

fields.name: window_hold
fields.evidence: Non-exported getter vtable +0x70 (f_71006b6d70) returns it; setter vtable +0x78 (f_71006b6d80) stores arg&1. update calls the getter and skips the window_frame decrement when true (timer paused). Initial 0; clear_setting writes 0.

fields.name: uniq_combo_id_b
fields.evidence: Written only by setter vtable +0x98 (f_71006b6dc0, int); no reader among the class's methods. Grouped with the hash pairs at +0x50/+0x60 (type 6 window params). Initial -1.

fields.name: type6_window_param_1
fields.how: plain load (two u64: param hash, sub-hash)
fields.evidence: Setter vtable +0xA0 (f_71006b6dd0); used by set for type 6 when count == 1. Initial 0.

fields.name: type6_window_param_2
fields.how: plain load (two u64: param hash, sub-hash)
fields.evidence: Setter vtable +0xA8 (f_71006b6de0); used by set for type 6 when count == 2. Initial 0.

fields.name: enable_combo_input
fields.how: computed: true if combo_type-4 > 2 unsigned (type not in 4..6), else this byte != 0
fields.evidence: is_enable_combo_input (slot +0xB0, f_71006b6df0). set writes 1 when type is 4..6 and window_frame >= 0; update writes 0 when the window of a 4..6 type expires. Initial 0. Bytes 0x71..0x77 are padding.

notes: Vtable 0x7104f85c38 has 23 entries (0x0..0xB0), one class (fighter). Slots +0x28 (f_71006b66a0) and +0x30 (f_71006b6800) register / unregister a 0x28-byte event listener (vptr 0x7104f85d00, callback 0x71006b6e20) in a list reached from owner_boma: [boma+0x18]+0x20 (list head), count at [boma+0x18]+0x18; +0x30 acts only when the u32 at boma+0x10 is < 2, then adds the listener if the u32 at boma+0x28 is nonzero (incrementing boma+0x2C), else unlinks it. +0x38 tail-calls clear_setting; +0x58 = reset export, tail-calls clear_setting (vtable +0x60); +0x60 = clear_setting: combo_type -1, count 0, window_frame -1, status_kind_at_set -1, window_hold 0 (does not clear +0x70 nor the hash pairs). +0x50 = per-frame update. The hash pairs and ids at 0x20..0x6F are configured by unexported setters (fighter-specific code).
